# Balakathā (Ps 2.9)

**ID:** Ps 2.9
**Section:** Paṭisambhidāmagga (ps)
**Collection:** Sutta
**Title (Pali):** Balakathā

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Balakathā* ("Discussion of the Powers") is the ninth treatise of the second division (*Yuganaddhavagga*) and nineteenth treatise overall in the *Paṭisambhidāmagga* [Gethin 2001]. The text opens with an exposition of the five spiritual faculties considered as powers (*bala*: faith, energy, mindfulness, concentration, and wisdom), but immediately expands to define an exhaustive composite list of sixty-eight powers [Gethin 2001]. As noted by R. M. Gethin, while the individual components of these sixty-eight powers are drawn from various groupings found throughout the four primary Nikāyas, the comprehensive list uniting them all into a fixed scheme is unique to the *Paṭisambhidāmagga* [Gethin 2001].
